---
name: fronto-backo-stricto
description: Fronto provides a set of web components that wrap the basic Stricto types. When a running Backo application is available, Fronto CLI tool will be used to generate the specialized web components that will map the data models exposed by Backo application routes. These web components are compound by the basic web components that wrap the basic Stricto types.
---

# References

Use the following links to access the documentation of the 3 complementary projects that Fronto relies upon:

- for Stricto reference, see the [Stricto documentation](https://stricto.readthedocs.io/en/latest/readme.html).
- for Backo reference, see the [Backo documentation](https://backo.readthedocs.io/en/latest/readme.html).

For more information on the architecture of Fronto, see the [Architecture Overview](../../../docs/architecture/overview.md) document.

Use that workflow when developing Fronto: identify package boundary, map Stricto type impact, update fixture/tests, then update docs if contract changed.
